info.title: Travel Planner API
info.description:
API-first travel planner. Everything the web app does goes through this API, so AI agents
have the same capabilities as the UI.

- Authenticate every `/v1` request with `Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>`.
- Timestamps are ISO 8601. Send them with an offset or `Z`; responses are always UTC (`Z`).
- Dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) are calendar days in the trip's IANA `timezone`.
- Errors are `application/problem+json` with a specific `detail` and, for validation
  failures, an `errors` array of `{path, message}`.
- Trips and activities return an `ETag`; send it as `If-Match` on a change to avoid
  overwriting someone else's edit (412 on mismatch).

A plain-language guide with workflows is at `/llms.txt`.

post.summary: Move an activity to another day
post.description: Moves an activity to `date` (or unschedules it with `date: null`). Without `startAt`, each time of day is kept, in the trip's timezone, on the new day. With `startAt`, the new times are used and an omitted `endAt` keeps the duration. An `idea` moved onto a day becomes `planned`; a `planned` activity that is unscheduled becomes `idea`.

MoveActivityRequest.title: MoveActivityRequest
MoveActivityRequest.description:
Body for `move_activity`.

- `date: null` unschedules the activity (and clears its times).
- `date` alone keeps each time of day, in the trip's timezone, on the new day.
- `date` with `startAt` (and optionally `endAt`) sets new times; an omitted `endAt` keeps the
  previous duration, and `endAt: null` clears it.

ScheduleInput.title: ScheduleInput
ScheduleInput.description:
When an activity happens. Omitted fields are null; all null means unscheduled.

- Only `date`: an all-day activity on that day.
- `startAt` (and optionally `endAt`): a timed activity; `date` is derived from `startAt` in
  the trip's timezone, so you can omit it. If you send it, it must agree.

UpdateActivityRequest.title: UpdateActivityRequest
UpdateActivityRequest.description:
Body for `update_activity`. Only the fields you send are changed; send null to clear
`location` or `notes`.

`schedule` and `location` are replaced as a whole: send the complete object. Send
`"schedule": null` to unschedule. To move an activity to another day while keeping its
times of day, use `move_activity`.

name.title: Name
name.description: New display name. Cannot be null.

color.title: Color
color.description: New avatar color as a `#rrggbb` hex string. Cannot be null.

UpdateTravelerRequest.title: UpdateTravelerRequest
UpdateTravelerRequest.description: Body for `update_traveler`. Only the fields you send are changed.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Cannot be null.

UpdateTripRequest.title: UpdateTripRequest
UpdateTripRequest.description:
Body for `update_trip`. Only the fields you send are changed; send null to clear
`destination`.

Changing `timezone` keeps every activity's UTC instants and recomputes the day of each timed
activity. Changing the dates or timezone is rejected if a scheduled activity would fall
outside the trip's dates.
